description: Open Dungeon Master runs multiplayer (and solo) Dungeons & Dragons 5e campaigns with an AI Dungeon Master, on your own machine. The narrator is whichever AI you already have: a local model (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM), an API key (OpenAI, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), or a CLI agent you already pay for (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Grok Build), which narrates on its own subscription with no API key handed over.
name: opendm
